title: IVG Savr 3000 Strawberry Watermelon Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Strawberry Watermelon IVG Savr 3000 Prefilled Pods combine the sweetness of ripe Strawberry with the light, hydrating flavour of fresh Watermelon. It’s a smooth and mellow vape that’s ideal for everyday use. Each pack contains a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, and a 4ml refill reservoir that clicks together for continuous use without manual refills. Combined, they offer up to 3000 puffs depending on usage habits. Mesh coil tech ensures clean, flavourful vapour. Designed for use with the IVG Savr 3000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit only. How to Set Up IVG Savr Prefilled Pod's Step 1: Unpack the Device Remove the cap from the mouthpiece. Take out the silicone stopper from the pod. Step 2: Prepare the Refill Peel off the red sticker. Remove the rubber stop. Step 3: Connect the Pod Align the refill with the pod. Press until you hear a click. Step 4: Insert into Device Slide the full pod-and-refill unit into the Savr device. Step 5: Prime the Coil Wait a few minutes to let the coil fully saturate. ✅ Ready to Vape! Inhale to activate and enjoy.
